name: Ecological sexual dimorphism and environmental variability within a community of Antarctic penguins (genus Pygoscelis)
description: Gorman, Williams & Fraser (2014), PLOS ONE 9(3): e90081. Morphometrics of Adélie, chinstrap and gentoo penguins breeding near Palmer Station, Antarctica (2007-2010), and sexual size dimorphism. Crate drafted by ReCRATE from the paper: the authors used R and published no code, so the method re-implements the size dimorphism index as the paper describes it.

methods.name: size_dimorphism_index
methods.description: Sexual size dimorphism index (SDI) per species for culmen length, culmen depth, flipper length and body mass, after Lovich & Gibbons (1992): mean of the larger sex divided by mean of the smaller sex, minus one, negative when males are larger (Table 2 of the paper).

inputs.name: input_dir
inputs.description: One row per individual: species (or another group), sex, and the four measurements

inputs.name: group_column
inputs.description: Column that defines the groups compared (the paper: species)
inputs.quote: An SDI was calculated for all structural parameters considered as best predictors of adult penguin sex for each species

inputs.name: sex_column
inputs.description: Column with the sex of each individual

inputs.name: male_label
inputs.description: Value of the sex column for males

inputs.name: female_label
inputs.description: Value of the sex column for females

inputs.name: keep_rows
inputs.description: Inclusion rule: rows to keep, as 'Column=Value' conditions separated by ';' (empty: every row)

culmen_length.note: Table 2 prints two decimals, so half a unit of the last decimal is 0.005; 0.006 adds a 0.001 margin, wider than rounding alone

culmen_depth.note: Table 2 prints two decimals, so half a unit of the last decimal is 0.005; 0.006 adds a 0.001 margin, wider than rounding alone

flipper_length.note: Table 2 prints two decimals, so half a unit of the last decimal is 0.005; 0.006 adds a 0.001 margin, wider than rounding alone

body_mass.note: Table 2 prints two decimals, so half a unit of the last decimal is 0.005; 0.006 adds a 0.001 margin, wider than rounding alone

followups.title: Exclude pairs that did not complete their clutch
followups.why: The paper excludes pairs whose second egg was never observed; the published data records this as Clutch Completion = No, and the method as drafted keeps them.
followups.quote: some pairs were excluded from statistical analyses because a final egg was never observed at the nest

methods.name: isotope_signatures
methods.description: Mean δ13C and δ15N stable isotope signatures of males and females, per year and species, with ± 1 SE (Figures 3, 4 and 5 of the paper). Redrawn from the published data: the figures are written as figures/figure-3.png, figure-4.png and figure-5.png, and the sample sizes the captions print are compared.

inputs.name: input_dir
inputs.description: One row per individual: species, sex, egg date (for the year) and both isotope values

inputs.name: keep_rows
inputs.description: Inclusion rule: rows to keep, as 'Column=Value' conditions separated by ';' (empty: every sexed individual)

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Sample sizes per species (as printed in the captions); the figures are in figures/

n_d13c.note: the captions of Figures 3, 4 and 5 print the sample sizes; counts are compared exactly
n_d13c.quote: based on sample sizes exactly following analyses
